whatThisIs: Successor to the 2026-09-07 targeted review for the task53 route-footer rerender. It chains the rerendered fixtures to the exact bytes that review examined: the only change is removed footer ink. It grants nothing; the reviewed content stands, the footer removal is task53's decision, and a fresh central raster of the new bytes is still owed.
reviewer: CI & Factory Claude (author QA of the measurement; not an independent post-repair approval)

comparison.pixelRule: no pixel darker on any page; ink removed only inside one band of at most maxBandHeightPx; the changed pages equal pagesCarryingARouteKey

visualReviewCarriedForward: The 2026-09-07 review examined pages 1-5 and 14-18 of each fixture and found the other 68 pages pixel-identical to the pre-repair packet. Every page of the rerender is that page minus its footer line, so that examination stands for the content.
stillRequired: Fresh central raster of the rerendered PDFs (owner dispatch); the raster queue row is RASTER_PENDING until it passes.
No verifier return pins the fixture bytes, so the independent verdict is unaffected; a later lane read measures the new bytes as usual.
